data.name: Maleehah
data.gender_notes: Maleehah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'malihah' meaning delicate, tender, gentle, or soothing. This name reflects the nurturing and caring nature of a mother. In Islamic history, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) used the term 'malihah' to describe the gentle treatment of his companions. The name Maleehah carries the meaning “Delicate, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maleehah usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with a gentle and nurturing spirit.
data.etymology: Maleehah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Tender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maleehah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
